children: ) today announced the 30th anniversary of its Singapore branch, marking three decades of serving clients across the Asia Pacific region. Since establishing its presence in Singapore in 1996, Northern Trust has continued to expand its support for asset owners, asset managers and family offices as they navigate an increasingly complex investment landscape.

Northern Trust Asset Servicing provides capabilities including global custody, fund administration, investment operations outsourcing, foreign exchange, securities lending, brokerage and other value-added services.

Northern Trust Asset Management serves institutional investors through a broad range of investment capabilities including Quantitative and Index Equity and Fixed Income solutions integrating sustainable investing as well as liquidity and cash solutions.

Northern Trust’s Global Family Office business established its Asia Pacific presence in Singapore in 2022. It serves single family offices and private investment companies with increasingly global and sophisticated needs, connecting them with capabilities spanning asset servicing, technology and reporting, lending and investments.

"For 30 years, Singapore has been a cornerstone of our Asia Pacific strategy and an important center for serving clients across the region," said Yen Leng Ong, country head of Singapore at Northern Trust. "We are proud of the relationships we have built and remain committed to investing in the people, capabilities, and technology needed to support our clients' evolving requirements."

The anniversary comes during a period of continued development for Northern Trust’s Singapore operations. Recent milestones include the launch of its Singapore unit trust offering, and the expansion of Northern Trust Asset Management’s liquidity capabilities.

"Singapore remains one of the most important investment centers in Asia Pacific, and we continue to see opportunities to support clients as their operating models, distribution ambitions and regulatory requirements evolve," said Angelo Calvitto, head of Asia Pacific at Northern Trust. "Our focus remains on helping clients achieve their objectives through innovative solutions, local expertise and the strength of our global network."

) is a leading provider of wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services to corporations, institutions, affluent families and individuals. Founded in Chicago in 1889, Northern Trust has a global presence with offices in 24 U.S. states and Washington, D.C., and across 22 locations in Canada, Europe, the Middle East and the Asia-Pacific region. As of September 30, 2026, Northern Trust had assets under custody/administration of US$19.9 trillion, and assets under management of US$2.0 trillion.
